name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: Thuwd trains skinners in Orgrimmar, so Horde adventurers traveling from Durotar can learn this wilderness craft there.
A proper campsite needs both a seat and heat. As a new skinner, you are encouraged to study cooking basics and learn to build a campfire.

aliases: who to speak to in orgrimmar
faq.answer: In Orgrimmar, Thuwd teaches skinners how to make camp items. Skinners speak with him after showing basic skill in their craft.
faq.q: Who teaches skinners how to make camp items?

aliases: what do skinners make for camp
faq.answer: Skinners can make a Camp Chair from the hides and pelts of fallen beasts. It offers a comfortable seat while they rest in the wild.
faq.q: What camping item can skinners craft?

faq.answer: City residents and guards frown on campsite equipment in town. Travel beyond settlement gates into the wilderness to pitch camp and set out your chair.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp chair inside a city?

faq.answer: A proper campsite needs a fire for warmth, visibility, and cooking. Before you pitch camp, ask a cooking trainer how to build a simple campfire.
faq.q: What else is required to complete a camp?

faq.answer: A comfortable chair gives you a place to rest between hunts and recover from the road before your next skirmish.
faq.q: Why should an adventurer craft a camp chair?

aliases: when can i learn camp chair
faq.answer: Thuwd shares the Camp Chair pattern after skinners prove basic skill at harvesting skins and hides from fallen beasts.
faq.q: When does Thuwd teach the Camp Chair pattern?

sections.body: In Orgrimmar, Thuwd teaches capable skinners to make a Camp Chair from cured hides. The pelts and hides of fallen beasts can serve beyond armorcraft. A skinner can put them to use in the wild.
sections.title: Comfort in the Wild

sections.body: Thuwd warns that guards and townsfolk frown on camps along busy city streets. A chair belongs in open country, away from settlement walls. A proper campsite needs a warm campfire, too. Cooks across Kalimdor teach the basics of making one.
sections.title: Rules of the Trail

summary: In Orgrimmar, new skinners are sent to Thuwd to learn the craft of camping. You make a Camp Chair from hides and pelts, then carry it beyond the city to open country.
